stories.label: Iran war Day 16: Iran declares Hormuz indefinite, Israel switches to regime targets
stories.summary: Day 16. Iran formally declares Hormuz blockade will last 'as long as war continues' — permanent wartime condition, not a pressure tactic. Israel shifts to regime targets (leadership, IRGC political structures) — war aim is now regime pressure, not just military degradation. Lebanon: 100,000 displaced in a single day; total surpasses 700,000. Iran cracking down on internal dissent. 140 US service members wounded. Mojtaba Khamenei as Supreme Leader forecloses near-term negotiation.

stories.label: Chile: Kast inaugurated; Lula boycott; Machado-Milei-Kast right bloc forming
stories.summary: Far-right Kast inaugurated in Chile with 90-day emergency plan (security, fiscal cuts, migration). Lula boycotted over Bolsonaro family's presence. María Corina Machado and Milei attended. A Kast-Milei-Machado political axis is taking visible shape — coordinated Latin American right. Chile's swing from Boric's social uprising-era election (2021) to Kast in 5 years is the deeper story.

stories.label: Hajj 2026: Indonesia formalises contingency planning as war continues toward pilgrimage season
stories.summary: Indonesia — world's largest Hajj delegation (220,000+ pilgrims) — formally preparing 'anticipatory scenarios' for if the war continues through Hajj season (begins late May 2026). 1.8 billion Muslims' most sacred obligation is now a logistics question. Saudi Arabia's ability to safely receive two million pilgrims while defending oil infrastructure is genuinely uncertain. First time Hajj contingency planning has been triggered by active war since 1979.

stories.label: Rubio designates Taliban's Afghanistan as state sponsor of wrongful detention
stories.summary: US designates Taliban Afghanistan as state sponsor of wrongful detention — unlocks new pressure tools (visa restrictions, financial sanctions). Taliban holding Americans as bargaining chips. US is managing Iran war + Afghanistan detainee crisis simultaneously with limited diplomatic bandwidth.

stories.label: Saudi Petroline East-West pipeline: can it replace Hormuz for Gulf oil?
stories.summary: Saudi Petroline (1,200km, 4.8 mb/d capacity) mobilised to bypass the Hormuz blockade. Key finding: Saudi Arabia has bypass capacity, Iraq and Kuwait do not. UAE has Abu Dhabi pipeline (~1.5 mb/d, insufficient). The war distributes energy resilience unequally — Riyadh gains structural leverage over Gulf neighbours and global oil supply.

stories.label: Bristol floating wind turbine and Europe's clean energy urgency under Iran war
stories.summary: Bristol floating offshore wind turbine — capable of deep-water deployment (60m+) where conventional turbines can't operate — becoming newly urgent as Iran war raises the cost of Gulf oil dependency. Floating offshore wind could unlock vast new North Atlantic capacity. Energy security and clean energy transition are the same question.

stories.label: Applied category theory: mathematicians model complex adaptive systems
stories.summary: Applied category theory (most abstract branch of math) being used to model supply chains, ecosystems, and social systems — the kinds of interconnected, cascading-failure-prone systems that the Iran war is currently breaking. Quanta Magazine feature. New field, emerging real-world relevance.

stories.label: China's YJ-12 supersonic anti-ship missiles: what if Iran acquired them?
stories.summary: Supersonic YJ-12 (Mach 2-3) anti-ship missiles reportedly close to export sale to Iran before US-Israeli strikes. If acquired, changes the threat calculus for every US warship in the Persian Gulf — Aegis interception window halves against supersonic vs subsonic missiles. China benefits from Iran having better deterrence. SCMP military analysis.

stories.label: HuggingFace leaderboard #1 achieved by duplicating neural net layers on gaming GPUs
stories.summary: Researcher duplicated specific middle layers of Qwen2-72B without changing weights and topped the HuggingFace Open LLM Leaderboard on two consumer GPUs. Challenges assumptions about optimal neural network architecture. Also reveals leaderboard gamability. Published on HN frontpage.

stories.label: RunAnywhere: edge AI inference on Apple Silicon beats cloud-targeting frameworks
stories.summary: YC W26 startup beats llama.cpp, Apple MLX, Ollama, sherpa-onnx on Apple Silicon benchmarks. Edge AI inference reaching parity with cloud for growing workload class. War-driven energy costs creating structural economic incentive for on-device AI.
